problem: Local timestamps without offset; zone stored apart in CZ_TIMEZONE with several labels (CST-6, MST-7); two-digit year
impact_on_design: Convert to UTC using the offset in CZ_TIMEZONE before any comparison with other sources

problem: Damage stored as text with K/M/B suffix; empty values mixed with '0.00K'
impact_on_design: Parse to numeric USD; keep empty as NULL (unknown), not 0

problem: No physical severity measure for floods (MAGNITUDE empty); severity must be derived
impact_on_design: Severity = rainfall from GHCN or impact (deaths/damage), not a native field

problem: Trace precipitation coded as PRCP=0 with measurement flag 'T'
impact_on_design: Keep the flag in the domain table; 0 mm with T is not the same as dry

problem: Daily value is a local-day total with no time zone; observation time in OBSTIME (values seen: (empty), 2400)
impact_on_design: Match to events by local calendar day (+/- 1 day), not by exact UTC instant

problem: precipitationLastHour is null in many observations (value: null, unitCode wmoUnit:mm)
impact_on_design: Only the hourly (METAR) reports carry precipitation; sum precipitationLastHour from those, never from 5-min reports

problem: Mixed reporting intervals, not hourly (median 5 min; most common: 5 min x954, 15 min x205, 10 min x151)
impact_on_design: Aggregate to fixed hourly/daily buckets; watermark per station on timestamp, not on count

problem: Alerts without geometry (only zone/county codes in affectedZones, text in areaDesc)
example: a938581ca63053af00abcf6f715cdb.001.1 Dense Fog Advisory: geometry=null, areaDesc='Caddo; Bossier; Webster; Claiborne; Lincoln; Union; De Soto;'
impact_on_design: Need NWS zone/county geometries to map alerts; join on UGC/SAME codes

problem: Timestamps in local offsets, not UTC (offsets seen: -05:00, -06:00, -07:00)
impact_on_design: Normalize every timestamp to UTC on ingestion

problem: Same warning re-issued as Update/Cancel with a new id (chain via references)
impact_on_design: Group alerts by reference chain; the latest message replaces earlier ones

problem: Feed mixes all hazards; flood-related events must be filtered by 'event'
impact_on_design: Filter on the event list in config/sources.yaml
